nuwa-skill-qszf 1.1.0 Changelog:

- Updated documentation and usage instructions in SKILL.md to version 1.2.0.
- Clarified the workflow for generating and optimizing new Skills.
- Added detailed description of data sources for research and skill distillation (local files, web search, existing Skills).
- Outlined new guidelines for Skill lifecycle, including cooperation with darwin-skill for evaluation and publishing process.
- Specified nine evaluation criteria for Skill optimization and defined ongoing quality assurance procedures.
- Expanded information on intended users and activation keywords.
